text:
amanda_fin: heads-up 45  Orchard Labs opened a billing dispute (TKT-4521). Sales promised first-month reserved capacity waived (experiment code: ONBOARD_FREE); invoice 80123 shows full reserved charge. Asking for a $10,000 credit + corrected invoice.

ryan_sales: doh. we added the experiment flag in the deal note but looks like billing cutoff missed the tag. did sales send a promo token to billing?

amanda_fin: not that i can see in SF note. invoice excerpt: ```
Invoice 80123
- Reserved capacity (ORD-RESV-PREM): $10,000
- Usage (ORD-USG): $1,420
- Discounts applied: $0 (expected ONBOARD_FREE)
Total: $11,420
```

emily_billing: quick clarifying q: was the waiver for the full reserved charge ($10k) or capped amount? ryan, what did sales promise?

ryan_sales: confirmed: full reserved charge waived for first month, uncapped. customer signed. 

amanda_fin: so recommended credit = $10,000. i'll route for approval. tag: "ONBOARD_FREE_ADJ".

cfo_jane: i'm ok to approve $10k one-time credit to preserve relationship. GL = 5110 (Sales credits & adjustments). please include business reason: "Experiment onboarding waiver promised but not applied; customer dispute TKT-4521."

emily_billing: approved by finance. generating credit memo and reissuing invoice 80123-R1 (net due $1,420). note: stamp "experiment: onboarding".

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-0055 created for $10,000. Reissued invoice 80123-R1 (net due $1,420). PDF: https://billing.internal/reports/invoice/80123-R1 

amanda_fin: emailed CM + corrected invoice to Orchard. cc @ryan_sales. asked for ack. Also added a billing-run checklist item: sales must confirm experiment flags 72h before monthly cutoff.

ryan_sales: will follow up with the AE and update partner playbook. apologies to Orchard. :bow: 

emily_billing: i'll close the ticket after Orchard confirms receipt. logging GL entry and tagging in month-end close notes.

amanda_fin: thanks all. can we also add a short retro in pricing-experiments board so engineering can surface the flag earlier?"
